meaning: Translation validation of the Lean front end against the TypeScript parser and elaborator it replaced, run before the TypeScript was deleted. Executed evidence about agreement on these inputs; not a correctness theorem.

parser.corpus: 68 git-tracked .obend files; 40 seeded mutants of each (delete/insert/duplicate-line/re-indent); 33 probes with and without an edition line

divergences.reason: deliberate: the TypeScript accepted `x valueOf x` (an Object.prototype key read as a precedence) and a string literal with a lone UTF-16 surrogate escape; the Lean parser refuses both

pipeline.lean: Host/ObjectiveBendFrontEnd batch (parse, import locks, elaborate, project, typing proposal)
pipeline.where: persvati lane elaborator, after the prelude became .obend source
pipeline.corpus: every non-type declaration of every tests/objective-bend-source/*.obend (definition mode), every preview-cohort invocation (application mode with its arguments and projections), and the 34 probes of objective-elaborate-tv.ts
pipeline.compared: core term; typing proposal types, annotations, bounds, shareable variables, fuel, context, source entry; or both unsupported; refusals must agree
pipeline.falsifier: a one-label mutation of a Lean term is detected by the same comparison
